bio.text: Patrick McCracken is the Libertarian candidate for Montana's eastern district U.S. House seat in 2026.
In an April 2026 Montana Public Radio interview, McCracken, 48, said he has lived in Montana his whole life, graduated from Billings West High School and attended school in Bozeman.
He said he worked as a financial advisor for 10 years and has spent most of his career of 20 years or more working with people on their finances.

sources.title: Q&A: Patrick McCracken, Libertarian eastern district U.S. House candidate
